Present petition has been filed with the following main reliefs:-
i) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing the undated order/letter/information in terms of award issued by opposite party no.
5(Annexure no. 5 and 6)
ii) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the opposite party no. 5 to not to demolish the building till the proper valuation is not taken place and provide compensation of the building only to the petitioner.
iii) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding and directing the opposite party no. 5 to provide compensation for the area 0.2660 of Gata No. 683 Gram Sonik, District Unnao instead of area 0.1770 as mentioned in the Khatauni (Annexure no. 9)."

sentences.text: Grievance of petitioner is that proper valuation of the building which has been acquired has not been done or no valuation has been done and that the area of land bearing Gata No. 683, which has been taken into consideration for determining compensation is less than the actual area.
All these issues can be seen under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Petitioner has filed an application under the said provision as claimed on 08.04.2023, if so and if it is otherwise maintainable in accordance with rules, the Collector shall proceed to consider and decide the same as per law.
If the limitation for filing such application has not expired yet and petitioner wants to file afresh application, he can do so, which shall also be considered accordingly, as per law.

opennyai_summary.facts:
Grievance of petitioner is that proper valuation of the building which has been acquired has not been done or no valuation has been done and that the area of land bearing Gata No. 683, which has been taken into consideration for determining compensation is less than the actual area.
All these issues can be seen under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Petitioner has filed an application under the said provision as claimed on 08.04.2023, if so and if it is otherwise maintainable in accordance with rules, the Collector shall proceed to consider and decide the same as per law.
If the limitation for filing such application has not expired yet and petitioner wants to file afresh application, he can do so, which shall also be considered accordingly, as per law.
Writ petition is disposed of.
